title: Forecasts being created with local IDs instead of backend IDs
description: Forecasts are being created with local IDs (e.g., 1769844910687-...) instead of backend IDs. This means when we try to add drivers, the backend returns 'Forecast not found'. Need to debug why backend forecast creation is failing or falling back to local.

title: Backend addDriver API returning 500 error
description: When trying to add a driver to a forecast, the backend API /api/forecasts?action=addDriver returns 500 Internal Server Error. This prevents drivers from being synced to the backend. Forecast ID: 1769844910687-...

title: Agent autocomplete working but agent mention fires multiple times
description: The @ agent autocomplete is now global and working, but the console shows 'Agent mention detected: research_analyst' and 'Setting agent being configured: research_analyst' multiple times. Need to investigate why the agent configuration is triggering repeatedly.
